title: Direct Knowledge Of Allah 19th Degree 1st Truth Proofs Of The 7 Attributes Especially Life

questions.question: How does the passage say the attribute of Speech makes Allah known?
questions.answer: It makes Him known through revelation and inspiration.

questions.question: How does the attribute of Power make Allah known in a different way?
questions.answer: It makes Him known through His made things and powerful works in creation.

questions.question: What comparison is used for the works made by Power?
questions.answer: They are compared to words that have taken a visible form.

questions.question: What does the whole universe act like when Power is looked at this way?
questions.answer: It acts like a living book spread across the whole cosmos.

questions.question: According to the passage, how does the attribute of Knowledge make Allah known?
questions.answer: It makes Him known through created things that are wise, organized, balanced, and specially arranged.

questions.question: Besides its own proofs, what other signs support the attribute of Life?
questions.answer: The signs of Power, the signs of Knowledge, and the proofs of the other attributes also support it.

questions.question: Which creatures are named as witnesses for Life?
questions.answer: Living beings are the witnesses.

questions.question: What do living beings reflect like mirrors?
questions.answer: They reflect many signs that point to Allah’s attributes.

questions.question: What does the passage say Life does to the universe again and again?
questions.answer: It keeps changing the universe to bring out fresh forms and new patterns.

questions.question: Why is the cosmos called a great mirror made of many small mirrors?
questions.answer: Because many created things show signs of Allah’s attributes.

questions.question: Which other attributes are said to reveal the Most Sacred Essence?
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Will, and Speech.

questions.question: What do the attributes show besides Allah’s existence?
questions.answer: They also show that He is living and everlasting.

questions.question: Why is Knowing a sign of Life in the passage?
questions.answer: Because knowledge belongs to one who is living.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the last part of the passage about Life?
questions.answer: Life has very many proofs, and it is presented as a central support for the other attributes.

questions.question: What are the two ways named in the passage by which Allah’s Speech becomes known?
questions.answer: Through revelation and inspiration.

questions.question: What does Allah’s Power use to point to Him?
questions.answer: It uses the skill and effects seen in created things.

questions.question: What does the universe “say” about its Maker in this passage?
questions.answer: It points to a glorious and powerful Creator.

questions.question: What makes the proof of Life stronger than only one kind of evidence?
questions.answer: Many different attributes and their signs all support it together.

questions.question: How do living things help people understand Life as an attribute?
questions.answer: Their existence serves as a witness to the One who gives and has life.

questions.question: What is one result of Life constantly working in the cosmos?
questions.answer: New forms and fresh designs keep appearing.

questions.question: How is change in the universe connected to Life in the passage?
questions.answer: Change is described as a way Life shows new displays again and again.

questions.question: Which four attributes are listed together after the discussion of Life?
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Willing, and Speaking.

questions.question: Why do Hearing and Seeing point to Life?
questions.answer: Because hearing and seeing belong to one who is living.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect Will to Life?
questions.answer: Because choosing belongs to a living being.

questions.question: Why is Speech linked with both Knowledge and Life?
questions.answer: Because speaking meaningfully requires awareness and life.

questions.question: According to the final sentence, how much of this truth is being given here?
questions.answer: Only a small part of a much bigger explanation.

questions.question: In the passage, what reveals Allah through messages such as revelation?
questions.answer: The attribute of Speech.

questions.question: What reveals Allah through the created world and its effects?
questions.answer: The attribute of Power.

questions.question: What picture does the passage give for the whole cosmos?
questions.answer: It presents the cosmos as a meaningful book.

questions.question: What can a reader understand from this “book” of the universe?
questions.answer: That there is a mighty and glorious Maker behind it.

questions.question: Through what kind of created things does Knowledge make Allah known?
questions.answer: Through things that are wise, orderly, balanced, and beautifully arranged.

questions.question: Does the passage treat Life as standing alone, or as supported by other signs too?
questions.answer: It is supported by many other signs too.

questions.question: Name two kinds of signs that also support Life.
questions.answer: Signs of Power and signs of Knowledge.

questions.question: What title is given to the Essence made known by Life?
questions.answer: Eternally Living and Self-Subsistent.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention ever-fresh designs in the world?
questions.answer: To show that Life brings ongoing new displays in creation.

questions.question: How do many small mirrors help explain the universe?
questions.answer: Many created things each reflect signs of Allah in their own way.

questions.question: What do the attributes prove about Allah’s life besides His existence?
questions.answer: They show His life is real and everlasting.

questions.question: What reasoning is used when the passage says willful power belongs only to the living?
questions.answer: Purposeful action points to a living source, not a lifeless one.

questions.question: Why is Life called a foundation for the other attributes?
questions.answer: Because many of the other attributes are understood as belonging to one who is living.

questions.question: Which attribute is connected with revelation and inspiration?
questions.answer: Speech.

questions.question: Which attribute is connected with skillful works in creation?
questions.answer: Power.

questions.question: If created things are like visible words, what do those “words” communicate?
questions.answer: They communicate the existence of their Creator.

questions.question: What does calling the cosmos a book help us understand?
questions.answer: It helps us see that creation has meaning, order, and a Writer.

questions.question: What features of creation are especially tied to the attribute of Knowledge?
questions.answer: Their wisdom, arrangement, balance, and beauty.

questions.question: How is the proof of Life broader than one single sign?
questions.answer: It is backed up by the proofs of many other attributes.

questions.question: Who are the witnesses that Life brings forward?
questions.answer: All living creatures.

questions.question: What do these living witnesses point to?
questions.answer: They point to Allah as the Ever-Living One.

questions.question: Why does the passage speak about the universe changing all the time?
questions.answer: To show continuing new displays of life and design.

questions.question: What does the mirror image teach about created things?
questions.answer: They reflect signs of Allah rather than having power by themselves.

questions.question: Which paired attributes are mentioned after Life?
questions.answer: Seeing and Hearing, and also Willing and Speaking.

questions.question: What common lesson joins Knowing, Hearing, Seeing, Will, and Speech in this passage?
questions.answer: They all point to life.

questions.question: Why can Speech not belong to something lifeless, according to the passage’s reasoning?
questions.answer: Because true speech needs life and knowledge.

questions.question: What conclusion does the passage make about the importance of Life?
questions.answer: It presents Life as a basic source and support for the other attributes.

questions.question: What is one way the passage says Allah makes Himself known besides creation?
questions.answer: Through revelation and inspiration.

questions.question: What is one way the passage says Allah makes Himself known through creation?
questions.answer: Through works that show His Power.

questions.question: Why might the passage compare created effects to words?
questions.answer: Because both can carry meaning and point to the one behind them.

questions.question: What does the universe show from one end to the other?
questions.answer: It shows signs of a powerful and glorious Lord.

questions.question: According to the passage, what kind of objects make Allah’s Knowledge known?
questions.answer: Objects that are wise, orderly, balanced, and carefully adorned.

questions.question: How does the passage build the case for the attribute of Life?
questions.answer: It gathers support from life itself and from the signs of the other attributes.

questions.question: Why are animate beings important in this proof?
questions.answer: Because their life acts as a witness to the Living Creator.

questions.question: What does the passage say Life does to the cosmos over time?
questions.answer: It keeps renewing it with different displays.

questions.question: What is the purpose of mentioning many mirrors inside one great mirror?
questions.answer: To explain how many things in creation reflect Allah’s signs.

questions.question: Which attributes are said to reveal Allah just as the cosmos does?
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Willing, and Speaking.

questions.question: What does Hearing tell us about the One described by it?
questions.answer: That He is living.

questions.question: What does Seeing tell us about the One described by it?
questions.answer: That He is living.

questions.question: Why is Life given such a high place in the passage?
questions.answer: Because many other attributes depend on it and point back to it.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the amount explained here compared with the whole subject?
questions.answer: It says only a very small portion is given here.

questions.question: In this passage, what makes Allah known through divine messages to people?
questions.answer: The attribute of Speech.

questions.question: In this passage, what makes Allah known through the things He creates?
questions.answer: The attribute of Power.

questions.question: What idea is taught by saying each work is like an outward word?
questions.answer: Every made thing carries a sign that points to its Maker.

questions.question: What does the image of a universe-sized book teach about creation?
questions.answer: Creation is meaningful, readable, and full of signs.

questions.question: What three groups of signs are mentioned as supporting Life?
questions.answer: Its own proofs, the works showing Power, and the forms showing Knowledge, along with the other attributes.

questions.question: What does Life make known about Allah’s Essence?
questions.answer: That He is Ever-Living and Self-Subsistent.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect constant change with Life instead of confusion?
questions.answer: Because the changes bring fresh, meaningful patterns, not disorder.

questions.question: What does the phrase about fresh manifestations suggest?
questions.answer: Allah keeps showing new signs in creation.

questions.question: Which attributes are said to make the Most Sacred Essence known in addition to Life?
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Willing, and Speaking.

questions.question: What is the logical link between Knowledge and Life in the passage?
questions.answer: Knowledge is a sign that the knower is living.

questions.question: What is the logical link between purposeful power and Life in the passage?
questions.answer: Purposeful power belongs to one who is alive.

questions.question: What is the logical link between Speech, Knowledge, and Life in the passage?
questions.answer: Meaningful speech belongs to one who has both knowledge and life.

questions.question: What overall lesson about Life should a 5th-grade student take from this passage?
questions.answer: Life is a major proof of Allah’s living nature and a key support for understanding the other attributes.
